## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation update
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring without behavioral change
- [ ] `test`: Unit or integration test addition
- [ ] `chore`: Build configuration or dependency update

## Safety Checklist

- [ ] Adheres strictly to the **Zero-Brick Policy** (no direct raw flash writes).
- [ ] Pre-flight safety checks are preserved and verified.
- [ ] All new logic is covered by unit or simulation tests.
- [ ] Tested locally on live Linux or Simulation Mode.
